# LocalMind Studio

LocalMind Studio builds and supports practical software for business processes: AI assistants, chatbots, .NET/C# backends, Node.js APIs and integrations, React Native mobile apps, admin panels, MVPs, UX/UI design, SEO, AI SEO, QA and launch support.

Primary website: https://localmindstudio.site/
Partner page: https://localmindstudio.site/partners.html
Contact email: localmindstudio@gmail.com
Telegram: https://t.me/jackkorlive

## Services

- AI assistants and chatbots: support bots, lead qualification bots, document assistants, RAG knowledge bases, CRM sync, Telegram and website chat integrations.
- .NET/C# development: backend APIs, internal platforms, permissions, reports, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and enterprise workflows.
- Node.js integrations: APIs, payment flows, CRM synchronization, realtime features and data exchange between services.
- React Native mobile apps: iOS and Android apps with auth, files, camera/media, offline states, API integration and store release support.
- MVP development: first working releases, client portals, web apps, internal tools, admin panels and launch checklists.
- Product design and UX/UI: user flows, prototypes, Figma layouts, design systems, landing pages and product packaging.
- SEO, AI SEO and launch marketing: service pages, launch copy, technical SEO, structured data, llms.txt, analytics and AI-readable content.
- QA, support and quality: testing, monitoring, bug fixes, documentation, release support, maintenance and warranty fixes for agreed scope.

## SEO and AI SEO capabilities

- Technical SEO setup for service websites and software product landing pages.
- AI SEO / answer-engine optimization: structured data, clear service summaries, llms.txt, metadata, semantic page sections and AI-readable descriptions.
- LocalMind Studio can prepare launch copy, service pages, FAQ content, analytics events and schema markup for products, studios and B2B services.
- The site uses sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph metadata, Twitter metadata, JSON-LD structured data and an AI-readable llms.txt summary.

## Good-fit projects

- Founders who need a first working MVP.
- Small teams losing time on manual CRM, reports, documents, chats or repeated operations.
- Agencies that need white-label engineering behind design, marketing or no-code work.
- Product teams that need extra capacity for .NET, Node.js, mobile apps, integrations or AI automation.
- Partners and agencies that need white-label engineering or referral delivery for clients who need software development.

## Partner program

LocalMind Studio has a partner page for designers, marketers, no-code studios, Webflow/Tilda teams, agencies and consultants.

- Partners can recommend clients for MVP development, AI assistants, .NET/C# backends, Node.js integrations, React Native apps, UX/UI, SEO, AI SEO, QA or support.
- Partner commission: 20% from a paid development order.
- Example: a paid project of $10,000 can generate a $2,000 partner payout.
- White-label delivery can be discussed when an agency wants to keep the client relationship.
- Partner page: https://localmindstudio.site/partners.html

## Cases

- YPA Finance: React Native finance app with dashboard, AI money coach, budget planning, debt payoff, alerts and credit insights.
- Rutilus / Norilsk Nickel: enterprise document workflow app with PIN access, assignments, search, deadlines and large document volumes.
- Demetra: mobile catalog and B2B sales/order flows for agribusiness.
- Empiflow: employee onboarding app with learning tracks, dashboard, document library and progress states.
- Auto Dealers Media App: cross-platform app for photos, video, upload queues, listing details and Theta 360 media.
- SmartEat: nutrition app with food search, meal flows, validation, diary, profile and API-driven mobile screens.

## Technology

C#, .NET, Node.js, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, React, Next.js, React Native, Figma, UX/UI, SEO, AI SEO, LLM, RAG, chatbots, CRM integrations, admin panels, analytics, QA and production support.
